thread:
nina-finance: Heads up284a2 we're launching improved tax handling and invoice metadata for VAT/GST territories. Live for invoice periods starting 2026-12-01.

nina-finance: Main pieces: 1) capture customer tax profile (VAT ID / tax residency), 2) support EU reverse-charge invoices (showing 0% VAT with reverse_charge flag), 3) tax-exempt org flag for verified non-profits and government entities, and 4) VAT line-item breakdown on hosted invoices. This is a billing/tax change only, not a pricing or rate-limit change.

thomas-sales: Will this require signed docs from customers to claim reverse-charge?

greta-legal: Yes, customers must provide a valid VAT ID and residency to enable reverse-charge. We added consent language to the billing flow. Sales: don't promise auto-acceptance; we may need to validate IDs via EU VIES and manual review for edge cases.

billing-bot: Example invoice lines (EU reverse-charge):
```
Invoice period: 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-31
Hosted API - rwd-v1-small | tokens: 1,200,000 | net: 48.00
VAT (0%) - Reverse Charge (customer VAT ID: EU123456789)
Total due: 48.00 (reverse-charge applied; VAT liability shifted to customer)
```

tax-engineer: Technical notes: we'll add a "tax_profile" object in the billing export (JSON/CSV column): tax_country, vat_id (redactable), tax_exempt=true|false, reverse_charge=true|false, applied_vat_rate. Exports will include sanitized values to avoid PII leaks.

support-lead: Support macro: "We now support VAT/tax profiles and reverse-charge invoicing. To request reverse-charge enablement, please provide your VAT ID and tax residency country in a reply. Our team will validate and respond within 3 business days."

thomas-sales: What about legacy invoices or unsettled charges for customers who supplied VAT IDs after the period start?

nina-finance: For invoices not yet finalized we will re-evaluate tax rules at finalization time. For already finalized and paid invoices we won't retroactively change taxes, but for unsettled (draft) invoices finance will apply adjustments if validation completes before finalization. We will also provide a one-time credit workflow for material mis-billing > $100 where validation proves reverse-charge should have applied.

greta-legal: Partner/reseller flows: if a partner invoices on behalf of end-customers, partner must supply end-customer tax profiles and accept liability per our partner terms. We're adding a partner-admin UI for bulk tax uploads.

tax-engineer: Ops please note: tax calc will run during invoice finalize job; we added a preflight check job to flag invalid VAT IDs. If preflight fails, invoice will finalize with a warning line and the account will be marked for manual review.

billing-bot: Sample warning line on invoice: "Tax validation pending: VAT ID provided but validation failed. Contact billing@redwood.ai to resolve."

support-lead: We'll add a KB: how to find VAT ID in EU registries, examples of accepted docs for tax-exempt orgs, and a playbook for refunds/credits. Expect +tickets during the first month.

thomas-sales: Any UI changes?

nina-finance: Billing UI: new Tax Profile tab (capture VAT/GST, residency, exemption docs upload), invoice detail shows tax breakdown and a "reverse_charge" flag. Also adding a column in billing CSV: applied_vat_rate and tax_note.

greta-legal: Reminder: don't promise tax outcomes to customers; we validate but final tax liability is the customer's responsibility. We added short legal language to the onboarding flow and invoice footers.

tax-engineer: Rollout plan: internal beta next week, limited external beta with select EU customers the week after, GA for invoices starting 2026-12-01. We'll publish the export schema and sample payload.

nina-finance: Thanks. If you see tricky cases (multi-entity orgs, reseller passthrough, treaty-exempt entities) add them to the tracker in the doc and tag me.
